note: First Wanted list (2026-11-25). Every item links to where the need came from. Governance Entry 001 actions 1 (investor communication with counsel) and 5 (gate token generation) are founder decisions, not network tasks, and are not listed.

items.title: Fix RPC reads failing with storage_writer_busy while the validator holds the database
items.why: Wallets and the explorer read the chain through RPC; while the validator writes, those reads fail.

items.title: Make the 4 failing node tests on main pass
items.why: Main must be green so every other fix can be checked.

items.title: Complete Asset-Orchard secret lifetime handling
items.why: Private swaps must not leave spending secrets in memory longer than needed.

items.title: Make the testnet monitor snapshot check pass on a transparent-only host
items.why: Independent validator operators run transparent-only hosts; the check always warns there.

items.title: Run one of the six independent validator operator slots on the controlled testnet
items.why: More independent validators make the network decentralised and are a gate for mainnet.

items.title: Run a Post Fiat validator and get it listed
items.why: Every new independent validator is public proof the network is not run by one person.

items.title: Code review of the PFSH03 curve-free private payment proofs
items.why: Quantum-safe privacy is the goal for the L1; the new proofs need an independent reviewer.

items.title: Governance action: scope Layer 1 engineering requirements and sequence the roadmap
items.why: Governance Entry 001 prescribes it: devnet stability, ML-DSA-65, Asset-Orchard swaps, SP1 NAV proofs, replay log, wallet recovery, private swaps and audits, in order.

items.title: Fix the validator payout worker giving up when the registry snapshot predates midnight
items.why: Validators can miss their monthly payout.

items.title: Fix direct-write task submissions getting stuck with empty summaries
items.why: Contributors who submit this way cannot get reviewed or paid.

items.title: Make daily airdrop feedback show the real reason instead of 'temporarily unavailable'
items.why: Members cannot tell why their airdrop score is what it is.

items.title: Re-queue failed profile NFT renders and fix the misleading retry message
items.why: New members can be left without a profile picture forever.

items.title: Stop the wallet address copy button reporting success when nothing was copied
items.why: People paste a wrong or empty address when sending funds.

items.title: Test Solana USDC deposit and withdrawal in the Task Node wallet end to end and fix what breaks
items.why: Bridging real money in and out is the newest money path; it needs testing by people other than the builders.

items.title: Governance action: stand up one metrics dashboard for conversion, product and financial metrics
items.why: Governance Entry 001 prescribes a single place for the metrics that gate token generation.

items.title: Show a rate-limited GPU provider as rate-limited, not 'no capacity'
items.why: Users are told there is no capacity when there is.

items.title: Stop sandbox start failing when a temp path vanishes during the deny-read scan
items.why: Sessions fail to start at random.

items.title: Make the Linux sandbox startup probe find the bundled bwrap
items.why: Users get a confusing prompt instead of a plain denial.

items.title: Migrate off the unmaintained chrono crate to jiff
items.why: chrono has a security advisory (RUSTSEC-2026-0543).

items.title: Add the Bedrock transport needed for Fable 5.2
items.why: Users on AWS Bedrock cannot use the newest model.

items.title: Spread the RKLB long trade idea (model target $85.65)
items.why: goodalexander trade ideas bring readers to Post Fiat; this one is from the 10 Nov models.

items.title: Spread the IREN trade idea
items.why: goodalexander trade ideas bring readers to Post Fiat; this one is from the 10 Nov models.

items.title: Spread the MRVL trade idea
items.why: goodalexander trade ideas bring readers to Post Fiat; this one is from the 10 Nov models.

items.title: Publish one actionable, sourced trade idea the community can use
items.why: The Trading board exists to give the community information it can act on: instrument, direction, thesis, evidence and what would prove it wrong.

items.title: Governance action: launch one measurable goodalexander conversion loop
items.why: Governance Entry 001 prescribes it: trade ideas with referral links plus a NAVCoin waitlist, tracked from click to funded account to waitlist.

items.title: Explain PFSH03 quantum-safe private payments in a public thread
items.why: It is the newest Post Fiat research (24 Nov) and the reason Post Fiat privacy survives quantum computers.

items.title: Explain the economics of NAVCoins for newcomers
items.why: NAVCoins are a core product and most people have never heard of them.

items.title: Make a short video showing how Task Node pays contributors
items.why: Video reaches people a written guide never will.

items.title: Publish a walkthrough of joining Task Node and finishing a first task
items.why: Newcomers drop off before their first task.
